statement: Provide bounded optional package-stage observation and explicit lab artifact custody without changing package command behavior, deadlines, assertions or placement outcomes. This diagnostic substrate enables investigation of OE bj0's retained 4260e562 installed-package timeout; it does not repair or explain that timeout, accept PR199/PR198/PR200, or establish release/native acceptance.

constraints.statement: No src changes, runtime repair, deadline extension, retry, assertion weakening, proof bypass or reinterpretation of predecessor acceptance. Keep command arguments, environment, ordering, synchronous execution and original errors/results/cleanup precedence unchanged. Observer failures remain explicit and cannot replace the original outcome.

Release packaging owns stage boundaries, the integration witness owns its diagnostic sink and outer lifecycle, and lab placement owns explicit bounded artifact collection before cleanup. No arbitrary environment/argument dumps, filesystem crawl, substantial timed tree hashing, network observation or trace records in the results ledger. Incomplete observation/custody is never causal evidence.

After independent plan and actual-diff reviews and narrow proofs, permit exactly one invocation of the unchanged package witness on a frozen diagnostic candidate using canonical runLabTest, named locked tv-dator, retries disabled and no controller fallback. Stop after that invocation to assess. A pass does not explain or erase the historical timeout; no automatic base comparison or second invocation.

Each semantic slice requires independent review and distinguishing tests. Required landing/exact-head gates remain separate. No completed repair, release, corpus or native claim follows from diagnostic evidence.
